How do I get my real estate business to show up in ChatGPT?

Short answer

ChatGPT tends to name agents it can confirm from public sources: a complete Google Business Profile, recent reviews, the same name and contact details everywhere, and pages and posts that tie your name to specific neighborhoods. An agent missing any of these is easier for AI to skip. LocalLift Signature's free AI report checks whether Google's AI names you in your city today.

The SocialDM · Nov 11, 2026
The problem

Why agents get skipped

01No Google Business Profile, or one with few photos and old reviews.
02A different name, phone or brokerage on your website, Zillow, Realtor.com and social pages.
03Nothing public that connects you to the neighborhoods you actually sell.
04Long quiet stretches with no fresh local posts.
A test you can run todayAsk ChatGPT for the best agent in your city in a private window while logged out. Your own account can be shaped by your past chats and saved memory, so the answer you see may differ from what clients see.
FAQ

Questions we hear

Is this the same as SEO?

Partly. AI pulls from many of the same places Google does, and it rewards facts that match everywhere.

Do social posts help?

Steady local posts keep your name tied to your area in public places AI can read. They work best alongside a complete Google profile and reviews.
